description_for_human: Model-visible live data for the 5 Bell parking garage.
description_for_model: Authenticated, read-only live garage data without camera image URLs. Always call the matching function together with its ParkAssist SPFx UX tool so the user receives both a same-turn factual answer and an interactive dashboard.

functions.name: garageOverviewData
functions.description: Return live 5 Bell occupancy, availability, out-of-service, and camera-health numbers as text and structured data.

responding.instructions: Quote the returned summary, exact metrics, and generatedAt timestamp in the current answer. Never tell the user to read a card for values this function returned.

functions.name: findAvailableSpacesData
functions.description: Return available-space totals and a bounded bay page, optionally filtered by floor or designation. Use totalMatches for the total; never count the bay page.

responding.instructions: Quote summary, totalMatches, floorBreakdown, scope, and generatedAt. The bays array is one page and must not be counted as the total.

functions.name: searchLicensePlateData
functions.description: Return occupied bay matches for at least three license-plate characters. Use only for a legitimate garage-operations request.

responding.instructions: Report only matches present in the response, including the generatedAt timestamp. Never infer missing plate characters.

functions.name: getStaleCameraFeedsData
functions.description: Return stale or missing camera-feed totals and affected bay metadata for the requested scope. Camera images remain on the paired SPFx UX tool.

responding.instructions: Quote summary, totalMatches, floorBreakdown, scope, and generatedAt. Explain that camera previews are rendered by the dashboard when available.
